contracts.commit_point: tools.py save_report body: os.makedirs(dirpath, exist_ok=True) at line 57 and open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') followed by f.write(content) at lines 59-60 — the point at which the filesystem mutation commits.
contracts.declared_mechanism: HumanInTheLoopMiddleware(interrupt_on={'save_report': True}) attached as middleware to the agent built by create_agent in build_supervisor, active on the module-level supervisor_agent = build_supervisor(hitl=True) instance; enforced end-to-end by main.py's handle_hitl loop, which polls agent.get_state for pending interrupts, renders the pending save_report call (filename and content preview), requires an explicit terminal 'approve' / 'edit' / 'reject' input, and only then resumes the graph with Command(resume={'decisions': [...]}) (approve at main.py:166-169; reject at main.py:187-191; 'edit' is realized as a reject-with-feedback resume asking the model to revise and call save_report again, main.py:172-184).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Execution of save_report's filesystem effect (os.makedirs of the report's parent directory and/or open(path,'w') + f.write(content) under the configured output directory) without a prior human 'approve' decision consumed through the HITL interrupt/resume flow — i.e., the tool body running while the interrupt is unresolved, or proceeding after a 'reject' decision.

contracts.protected_resource: The report file at the path constructed as './' + settings.output_dir + '/' + filename (tools.py:54), including the parent directory created via os.makedirs (tools.py:57); filename and content are agent-supplied tool arguments.
contracts.protection_obligation: The supervisor agent must interrupt the save_report tool for explicit human approval (HumanInTheLoopMiddleware with interrupt_on={'save_report': True}) before the tool's concrete disk-write effect — creating the output directory and opening/writing content to the report path — is allowed to execute. The write may proceed only after the user supplies an 'approve' decision that is delivered back to the agent as a resume Command.
scope_limits: The guard exists only on the supervisor_agent instance built with hitl=True (supervisor.py:38); build_supervisor(hitl=False) substitutes an empty middleware list (supervisor.py:22-24), so any agent built that way (the docstring mentions tests) is outside this obligation.

interrupt_on names only 'save_report' (supervisor.py:23); the other supervisor tools (plan, research, critique registered at supervisor.py:31) and the tools.py tools web_search, read_url, and knowledge_search are not covered by this interrupt.

Enforcement is in-process and client-side: the middleware interrupt plus the CLI resume loop in main.py handle_hitl; no independent server-side, OS-level, or filesystem-level enforcement appears in the supplied source.

handle_hitl examines only state.interrupts[0] and action_requests[0] (main.py:119-125); how multiple simultaneous pending action requests would be surfaced or decided is not specified by the supplied source.

The 'edit' decision is implemented as a reject-with-feedback resume (main.py:172-184) that requests a revised save_report call; this obligation re-applies to that subsequent tool call as a new interrupt cycle.
